annotations.title: Turn an AppLovin campaign or creative set live or paused

description: LIVE or PAUSED for an AppLovin campaign (campaignId) or creative set (creativeSetId), read back. LIVE starts real ad spend: show the user the budget, get an explicit yes, then call with confirm:true. Pausing is always safe. AppLovin’s API has no delete; pause instead. Needs the Campaign Management key, which exists once AppLovin enables API access on the account; without it the answer says how to get it.

campaignId.description: AppLovin campaign id; pass this or creativeSetId

creativeSetId.description: AppLovin creative set id; pass this or campaignId

level.description: inferred from the id you pass

status.description: LIVE starts real spend; PAUSED stops delivery

name: set_applovin_ads_status
